(walk {s} 0)

(def apply-op [f st] (cons (f (head (tail st)) (head st)) (tail (tail st))))
(def step [st toks] (if (nil? toks) (head st)
  (let t (head toks)
    (cond (eq t "+") (step (apply-op merge st) (tail toks))
          (eq t "-") (step (apply-op sub st) (tail toks))
          (eq t "*") (step (apply-op mul st) (tail toks))
          (step (cons (parse-int t) st) (tail toks))))))
(step (nil) (words {s}))

(def apply-op [f st] (cons (f (head (tail st)) (head st)) (tail (tail st))))

  (let x (head xs)
    (if (gt x prev) (walk (tail xs) x (inc cur) best)
                    (walk (tail xs) x 1 (max cur best))))))
(def go [xs] (if (nil? xs) 0 (walk (tail xs) (head xs) 1 1)))
(go (map parse-int (words {s})))

(def walk [xs acc] (if (nil? xs) acc
  (let v (val (head xs))
    (if (nil? (tail xs)) (merge acc v)
      (if (lt v (val (head (tail xs)))) (walk (tail xs) (sub acc v)) (walk (tail xs) (merge acc v)))))))

(kth (sort (append (map parse-int (words {a})) (map parse-int (words {b})))) {k})

(find (map parse-int (words {s})) {target} 0)

(def count [m w] (map-put m w (inc (map-get m w 0))))
(def maxl [xs acc] (if (nil? xs) acc (maxl (tail xs) (max acc (head xs)))))
(maxl (map-vals (fold (lambda m (lambda w (count m w))) (map-of (nil)) (words {s}))) 0)

(def at [xs i] (if (eq i 0) (head xs) (at (tail xs) (sub i 1))))
(def cell [xs n i j] (mul (at xs (merge (mul i n) j)) (at xs (merge (mul j n) i))))
(def row [xs n i j acc] (if (eq j n) acc (row xs n i (inc j) (merge acc (cell xs n i j)))))
(def all-rows [xs n i acc] (if (eq i n) acc (all-rows xs n (inc i) (row xs n i 0 acc))))
(all-rows (map parse-int (words {s})) {n} 0 0)

(def walk [xs prev acc] (if (nil? xs) acc
  (let c (head xs) (walk (tail xs) c (if (eq c prev) acc (inc acc))))))
(walk {s} (neg 1) 0)

(def best [coins m i] (if (nil? coins) (map-get m i (neg 1))
  (let c (head coins)
    (let rest (best (tail coins) m i)
      (if (gt c i) rest
        (let sub-best (map-get m (sub i c) (neg 1))
          (if (lt sub-best 0) rest
            (if (lt rest 0) (inc sub-best) (min rest (inc sub-best))))))))))
(def fill [coins m i amount] (if (gt i amount) m
  (fill coins (map-put m i (best coins m i)) (inc i) amount)))
(map-get (fill (map parse-int (words {coins})) (map-put (map-of (nil)) 0 0) 1 {amount}) {amount} (neg 1))
